claim: 2026 Michelin Guide confirms Osaka's three 3-star restaurants are Hajime, Kashiwaya Osaka Senriyama, and Taian
quote: Japanese restaurants Taian and Kashiwaya Osaka Senriyama, as well as innovative restaurant Hajime, remain the only three establishments with the highest star ranking in the city.

claim: Hajime and Kashiwaya Osaka Senriyama have held 3-star status continuously from 2021 through 2026
quote: Hajime - Innovative cuisine; Kashiwaya Osaka Senriyama - Japanese cuisine; both maintained 3-star status 2021-2026.

claim: Hajime's signature Chikyu dish features 110 ingredients representing the cycle of life on the planet
quote: Chikyu (Earth) features an impressive 110 ingredients including vegetables, grains, herbs, and seafood foam, representing the cycle of life on the planet on a plate.

claim: Hajime dinner starts from ¥35,900; jacket and dress shoes required for men; seats 22; children 16 and up only
quote: From ¥35,900 (approximately $250 USD). Dress shoes and a jacket required for male guests. Children 16 and up welcome. 22 seats.

claim: Hajime standard tasting menu costs approximately ¥45,360; the Chikyu dish arranges ~100 ingredients like a mountain landscape descending to the sea
quote: The experience cost ¥45,360 ($406 USD) for the standard tasting menu. Chikyu features nearly 100 ingredients arranged on an enormous shared plate designed to resemble a mountain landscape descending to the sea.

claim: Hajime earned three Michelin stars 17 months after opening, the fastest ascent in Japanese culinary history
quote: Hajime opened in 2008 and achieved three Michelin stars just 17 months later—the fastest ascent in Japanese culinary history.

claim: Chef Hajime Yoneda's stated mission is to create the ultimate emotion in the world
quote: Chef Hajime Yoneda, whose mission is to 'create the ultimate emotion in the world.'

claim: Kashiwaya dinner courses range from ¥28,500 to ¥83,500 including an ¥8,000 booking fee; minimum 2 guests; children 12+
quote: ¥28,500–¥83,500 per person depending on course selection. All prices include an ¥8,000 booking fee. Minimum: 2 guests. Children: 12 and older.

claim: Kashiwaya features sukiya-zukuri architecture across 7 private dining houses with garden views; interior by master craftsman Toshiyuki Nakamura
quote: Interior designed by master craftsman Toshiyuki Nakamura; visual garden views; tea ceremony-inspired interior creating an immersive seasonal experience.

claim: Kashiwaya is on the World's 50 Best Discovery list as a notable Osaka fine-dining destination
Taian dinner omakase costs ¥33,500 including an ¥8,000 booking fee; 16 counter seats; closed Mondays; features an open charcoal grill
quote: The omakase dinner course costs ¥33,500 (includes ¥8,000 booking fee). Service runs 5:30-8:00 PM, closed Mondays. Features an open charcoal grill.

claim: Taian blends traditional Kaiseki with modern sensibilities in a counter ryotei format with 16 intimate seats
quote: Taian blends traditional Kaiseki techniques with modern sensibilities, presenting what's described as 'Ryotei fare in counter kappo style.'

claim: Taian is located at 1-21-2 Shimanochi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; near Nagahoribashi Station
Chef Hitoshi Takahata spent 15 years at Ajikitcho before opening Taian in 2000; allows guests to choose from 5 main course options unlike typical kaiseki
quote: Chef Hitoshi Takahata spent fifteen years honing his craft at Ajikitcho before opening Taian in 2000. Guests can choose from a set of five or so main courses.

claim: My Concierge Japan provides English-language reservation assistance for Michelin-starred restaurants in Osaka, Kyoto and Tokyo
quote: Best Restaurants Reservation Michelin Star & Kobe Beef | Osaka Kyoto Tokyo | My Concierge Japan

claim: Hajime and Taian are among the 13 Michelin three-star restaurants in Japan accessible via online reservation platforms for foreign tourists
quote: 13 Reservable Michelin Three-Star Restaurants in Japan - OMAKASE JapanEatinerary

claim: The 2026 Michelin Guide Kyoto & Osaka was announced in April 2026 with Osaka retaining three 3-star restaurants unchanged
quote: Michelin unveils a new three-star restaurant in Kyoto in six years

quote: Reserve Kashiwaya Osaka Senriyama – Michelin 3-Star Restaurant in Osaka - Rakuten Travel Experiences
